control_scale.meaning: Relative visual direction for GPT-Image-2 and ChatGPT Images 2.0, not an API parameter or measured press specification

fine_uncoated_offset.label: Fine uncoated offset
fine_uncoated_offset.summary: Image-first, high-frequency offset reproduction on quiet uncoated stock with open middle values and restrained absorption.
prompt_anchors: The bounded photographic image is formed by a fine high-frequency screen while the carrier, real objects, paper borders, and solid type retain their own material behavior.
Paper channels remain open through three-quarter tones; black reads as absorbed gray-black ink rather than a sealed digital mass.
Paper tooth, slight dot gain, and ink-load variation are close-view evidence, not the first visual event.
fine_uncoated_offset.tradeoff: Most faithful and refined; the screen deliberately remains secondary at normal size.

refined_visible_offset.label: Refined visible offset
refined_visible_offset.summary: A visibly screened but still editorial offset reproduction with moderate rosette presence and controlled tonal reduction.
prompt_anchors: The screen is perceptible at normal viewing size but remains subordinate to faces, objects, and reading order.
Midtones visibly resolve into organized dots without flattening into poster bands.
Registration stays clean and paper absorption remains restrained.
refined_visible_offset.tradeoff: More obvious print character, with modest loss of tiny photographic detail.

screenprint_spot.label: Spot-color screenprint
screenprint_spot.summary: Two to four opaque stencil-printed spot colors with firm ink deposits, deliberate tonal steps, and optional screened image regions.
prompt_anchors: Use two to four named spot inks with opaque deposits and purposeful overprint rather than process-color photographic smoothness.
Mesh and stencil evidence stays subtle in solid areas; screened dots appear only where a source image requires tonal reproduction.
Edges have minute ink deposit character while silhouettes, type, and registration remain intentional.
screenprint_spot.tradeoff: Strong physical graphic character; continuous photographic nuance is intentionally reduced.

risograph_spot.label: Risograph spot-color editorial
risograph_spot.summary: Two or three translucent spot inks on porous stock with controlled overprint, modest registration variation, and economical editorial rhythm.
prompt_anchors: Use two or three named translucent spot inks whose overlaps create secondary colors.
Keep registration variation small and directional rather than random damage.
Porous paper and ink density variation are visible close up while the page remains designed and clean.
risograph_spot.tradeoff: Warm and tactile, but color overlap and registration variation reduce exact photographic fidelity.

photogravure_monochrome.label: Monochrome photogravure
photogravure_monochrome.summary: Quiet monochrome photomechanical reproduction with long tonal scale, ink-rich shadows, and restrained paper tooth.
prompt_anchors: Use one restrained ink family with a long tonal scale and fine photomechanical cell character.
Keep highlights delicate and middle values continuous in perception while shadows remain open enough to show form.
The result is a clean contemporary reproduction, with material evidence rather than theatrical aging.
photogravure_monochrome.tradeoff: Excellent tonal depth and restraint; unsuitable when lively multicolor separation is central.

restrained_editorial.label: Restrained editorial
restrained_editorial.summary: Quiet hierarchy, material-led color, disciplined whitespace, and typography that supports rather than performs.
prompt_anchors: Use one decisive focal subject, one supporting read, and abundant calm space.
Let physical material and source evidence determine color; avoid decorative motifs without a source relationship.
Typography, when authorized, uses at most two voices and remains informational.
restrained_editorial.tradeoff: Highest material credibility and longevity; deliberately avoids spectacle.

pop_graphic.label: Pop graphic
pop_graphic.summary: Large flat color relationships, bold scale jumps, concise display type, and a clear image-versus-shape rhythm without imitating a named artist.
prompt_anchors: Build one large graphic color event and one dominant subject rather than filling the page with equal motifs.
Use a concise two-to-four-color relationship, decisive crop, and bold display type only when copy is authorized.
Keep source identity and physical boundaries intact; graphic simplification must be deliberate, not a generic comic treatment.
pop_graphic.tradeoff: Immediate visual impact; sacrifices some quiet tonal nuance and demands tighter copy discipline.

modernist_grid.label: Modernist grid
modernist_grid.summary: Measured alignment, asymmetric grid tension, objective sans typography, and controlled geometric intervals.
prompt_anchors: Use an explicit grid with unequal modules, disciplined alignments, and one controlled break in the system.
Prefer neutral sans typography and exact spacing relationships over decorative lettering.
Geometric order must organize the supplied content rather than invent unrelated circles or diagrams.
modernist_grid.tradeoff: Clear and systematic; can feel impersonal when the source relationship is weak.

scientific_plate.label: Scientific plate
scientific_plate.summary: Evidence-led plate composition with a primary specimen, restrained notation, measured margins, and exact information hierarchy.
prompt_anchors: Treat the subject as evidence: one primary specimen, one or two supporting views, and only authorized labels.
Use measured margins, small neutral type, precise leaders only when they point to real source features, and ample paper field.
Every annotation must carry information; decoration cannot masquerade as data.
scientific_plate.tradeoff: Strong evidence structure; requires real labels and can become sterile if annotations are invented.

generic_print.label: Refined editorial print
generic_print.reason: Safest image-first default with believable paper, ink, and material separation.

generic_print.label: Polished pop offset
generic_print.reason: Adds bold composition and color while retaining fine photographic reproduction.
generic_print.tradeoff: More graphic and less quiet than the default.

generic_print.label: Physical pop screenprint
generic_print.reason: Uses opaque spot inks and stencil logic when the printing process itself should be visible.

photographic_fidelity.label: Fine editorial offset
photographic_fidelity.reason: Preserves faces, product geometry, middle values, and source color relationships.
photographic_fidelity.tradeoff: Close inspection is needed to read the screen.

photographic_fidelity.label: Monochrome tonal depth
photographic_fidelity.reason: Best when portrait or landscape modeling matters more than color.
photographic_fidelity.tradeoff: Commits the image to one ink family.

photographic_fidelity.label: Visible modernist offset
photographic_fidelity.reason: Shows more screen structure within a controlled editorial system.
photographic_fidelity.tradeoff: Tiny source detail is slightly reduced.

bold_graphic.label: Polished pop offset
bold_graphic.reason: Keeps source detail while shifting layout, scale, color, and type toward a bold Pop direction.
bold_graphic.tradeoff: The process remains refined rather than obviously handmade.

bold_graphic.label: Spot-color pop screenprint
bold_graphic.reason: Makes opaque ink layers and stencil logic part of the design.

bold_graphic.label: Riso pop edition
bold_graphic.reason: Adds translucent spot-color overlap and modest registration character.
bold_graphic.tradeoff: Exact color and edge fidelity are lower.

handmade_color.label: Quiet riso editorial
handmade_color.reason: Balances porous stock and spot-color overlap with a disciplined composition.
handmade_color.tradeoff: Registration and color overlap are intentionally less exact.

handmade_color.label: Modernist screenprint
handmade_color.reason: Uses strong spot inks inside a measured grid.

handmade_color.label: Clean evidence plate
handmade_color.reason: Offers tactile paper and disciplined information without strong process artifacts.

monochrome_depth.label: Quiet photogravure
monochrome_depth.reason: Prioritizes long tonal scale and ink-rich photographic depth.

monochrome_depth.label: Monochrome evidence offset
monochrome_depth.reason: Retains precise forms and supports restrained factual annotation.

monochrome_depth.label: Visible monochrome grid
monochrome_depth.reason: Makes the screen and layout system more explicit.
monochrome_depth.tradeoff: Less tonal subtlety than the first option.
